title: WhaleRein remote control
intro: Encrypted remote control for DeepSeek Harness sessions. The host plugin is a protocol endpoint: it opens one outbound MQTT connection and no HTTP listener.
adapterValue: Real DSH or FakeDSH, selected at startup
configurationHint: Values come from the DSH profile environment. Restart the profile after changing them.
note: Never put the host token in this page. It is read from the profile environment and is not rendered by the settings UI.
